hero.title: SOFTWARE DEVELOPER.
hero.bio: I code out of curiosity. I build things to use them.

about.title: Frontend, architecture
about.paragraph1: I’ve been programming since 2013 and working professionally since 2020. Frontend and the React ecosystem are where I have the most experience. They’re also the areas I most enjoy working in. My professional experience also includes backend and mobile application development.
about.paragraph2: In my professional work, I’ve worked on software architecture and as a Tech Lead while continuing to write code. Architecture and implementation went hand in hand. My portfolio shows that same range: from an idea and the choice of an approach to a working project.
about.paragraph3: In my personal projects, I bring together different disciplines to build things that meet practical needs. In my smart home system, I connected a React interface with Node.js logic and device communication. With PiGuard and VHS HTPC, the work also involved electronics, enclosures and 3D printing.
about.paragraph4: I also worked professionally on AI-powered tools before coding assistants such as Codex and Claude Code became widely used. Today, I also use AI to help me write code. For Gauge Generator, I wrote specifications, broke the work into stages and reviewed the generated code myself. For PiGuard, AI support let me spend more time on the electronics and building the device. I describe these experiences in more detail in the individual project stories.
